subtopic: Idempotency Keys and Distributed Request Retries
question_text: Where should a client place an Idempotency Key in a RESTful payment API request to ensure safe retries over unreliable networks?

options.text: Appended to the database table name

answer_explanation: Idempotency keys belong in HTTP request headers. Query params risk being logged in plain text in access logs and proxy caches, while headers keep URLs clean and resource-oriented.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: B. Rationale: Idempotency keys belong in HTTP request headers. Query params risk being logged in plain text in access logs and proxy caches, while headers keep URLs clean and resource-oriented.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: Selects the exact correct technical option.
